title: The Sunflower Patch
_comment: Reskinned from riverbend/ch01 — same 960s workout, same beat ids at the same offsets, because that pacing was tested on a real jog with a six-year-old and worked. Only the surface changed. Gus and the pickle jar are unchanged on purpose.

beats.text: Runner Two, this is Ruby at Sunnyside. I've got you on the radio. Start with an easy walk and warm those legs up.
Here's the situation. The sprinklers gave out in the night and the sunflower patch has wilted. It made a sound like a whale sighing. We need sun.
The garden shed is just down the road. In, out, easy. Oh, and there are a few zombies wandering about. But honestly? They are not very good at it.
Warm up's nearly done, Runner Two. Get those legs ready to jog.

beats.name: Jars of sun
beats.text: Great jogging! Walk it out now. And look down, by the mailbox. Two jars of sun that somebody dropped. Grab them!
Two jars in the bag. Those sunflowers are going to drink well tonight because of you.
Keep it going! You are faster than anything out here.

beats.name: Jars of sun
beats.text: Garden shed's just ahead, and the door is wide open. Shelf on your left. Two more jars of sun. That's plenty.
Uuuurgh. Snaaaacks?
Ha! That's just Gus. He has been trying to open the same jar of pickles for a month. Keep walking, he will never catch you.
Jogging again. Nice and light.

beats.name: Watering Can
beats.text: Hold on. On the bench there. A watering can! Take it. That one is yours now, Runner Two.
Okay. Slight problem. Gus has friends. And they have noticed you.
Get ready to run. On my mark.
Go! Sprint to the end of the street! They are slow and you are fast. Run!
Almost there! Five more seconds! Four! Three! Two! One!
You lost them! And Gus tripped over a garden gnome. He's fine. He is apologising to it.
Walk it off, Runner Two. Big deep breaths. That was brilliant running.

beats.name: Jar of sun
beats.text: Wait. There's one more jar sitting in that flowerbed. We are definitely going to need that.
Home stretch now. Jog it out.

beats.name: Jars of sun
beats.text: Two more jars leaning against the fence. Last ones, I promise.
You know what? The kids at Sunnyside have been asking about you. They call you the fast one.
Last jog of the day. Make it a good one!
That's it. That was the last one. Walk it home, Runner Two.
I can see you from the porch. Opening the gate now.
You're home. Slow it right down and shake those legs out.
Seven jars of sun and a watering can. That is a proper haul. Take it out to the lawn and get something growing.
Get some rest. Next time we are going up the hill to the old greenhouse. Ruby out.
